'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey there, tourist. How's life in Tarkov treating you? I figured your kind would be softer than this. Ah, never mind, let's get to business.

Everything's piling up on me at once. I'm out of grenades, and my clients are being a pain in the ass. I need your help. Show those idiots that the GP-25 underbarrel grenade launcher really gets the job done. And while you're at it, gather me some grenades. Our grenades, domestic Soviet ones.}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only obtainable by [[USEC]] PMCs.

==Objectives==
* Hand over 10 any [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] Russian grenades to [[Prapor]]
* Eliminate any 10 targets with a [[GP-25 Kostyor 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher|GP-25 grenade launcher]]

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 275,000 Roubles
** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Military power filter]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[Korund-VM ballistic plates (Front)]] at [[Prapor]] LL3
* Unlocks purchase of [[23x75mm Zvezda flashbang round]] at [[Prapor]] LL3
{{quote|Hm... well, alright. Old offenses are forgotten, let's keep working. Just be careful around that Skier character, he's a shady dude.}}

==Initial Equipment==
* Unlocks purchase of [[40mm VOG-25 grenade]] at [[Prapor]] LL3
* Unlocks barter of [[GP-25 Kostyor 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher]] at [[Prapor]] LL3
